sourceMethod: Read existing local NeoForge 21.1.259 resource/source artifacts without launching or modifying Minecraft.

algorithm.pixelFormat: NativeImage ABGR32; channel-equivalent RGBA conversion preserves RGB and alpha exactly.
rules: Build a row-major map from nonzero-alpha key-palette RGB to corresponding permutation-palette RGBA; later duplicate key colors win.
Fully transparent source pixels are returned unchanged, including their RGB channels.
For other pixels use mapped target RGB/alpha, or original RGB with alpha 255 if absent from key palette.
Output alpha = floor(source alpha * mapped alpha / 255).
